additional_info.subject: Urgent Assistance – SiCharge D Charger Without Internet Connection
additional_info.body:
Hello colleagues,
We have a SiCharge D charger ( Serial Number
MP / P9 170000994 and  MP / P7 170000780)
that had its screen replaced due to peeling. The replacement was successful, but the charger is currently unable to connect to the internet.
A technician is on site and verified that the SIM card is working properly; however, the issue appears to be with the charger itself, which is not loading data
. We believe it could be a system update issue.
Could you help us resolve this issue? It's a priority to resolve it as soon as possible, as the technician traveled over 300 km to perform the repair.
Thank you very much,
BR
Sofia A. Lezcano
Project Manager
Siemens SA
Parque Industrial Newton
Calle Cuba 4870, Ruta 8 - Km. 18

additional_info.subject: 0450705 - ID0450705-DC/Si-D/AR-[MP / P9 170000994] Charger is unable to connect to the internet CRM:00263000091
additional_info.body:
Hello Sofia,
We have checked the charger and the problem is on the router, we made a factory reset to understand if it need to be replaced or not.
If you can do a reboot remotely please do it, otherwise you need to go onsite and take a spare router with you.
Upon reviewing our asset database, we found that this product is no longer under warranty, as a result, we are only able to support the topic for 1 hour. After that it is necessary to order support from us. Please let me know if you would like to order support for this topic, so I can prepare an offer. You can also reach out to Rui Teodoso (
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
) or Afonso Sousa (
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
).
In case it's not needed support, let me know and we can close the ticket, if you prefer to have the ticket in your side to follow up just let me know. Thank you!
With best regards,
Guilherme Andre De Verissimo Dias
Siemens S.A.
SI E CS SD L3
201, Avenida 25 de Abril
2845-547, Corroios, Portugal
